revision.description: The revision of the current shape; every revise takes a new one.

publishedRevision.description: The revision last published (0 = never). Shoppers see this revision; a PUBLISHED content with revision above it waits for a publication.

retiredReason.description: Present exactly when the state is RETIRED.

publishedAt.description: Present once a revision was published.

retiredAt.description: Present exactly when the state is RETIRED.

allOf.description: The editable content, replaced as a whole by create and revise (an absent field means empty). Texts are trimmed and free of control characters. Bounds: 10 bullets, 50 attributes, 12 media; a violation is 422 too-many-bullets, too-many-attributes or too-many-media.

description.description: Trimmed text; empty or absent on a draft, required to publish.

items.description: Texts are trimmed (no leading or trailing whitespace) and free of control characters; a violation is 422 validation-failed.

unit.description: Optional; null or absent means no unit. A response omits it when there is none.

items.title: Attribute

allOf.description: Opaque id, 1 to 64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - starting with a letter or a digit.
allOf.title: Id

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL (host required, no surrounding whitespace) to a static asset; media upload is out of scope.

allOf.description: Opaque id, 1 to 64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - starting with a letter or a digit.
allOf.title: Id

primaryCategoryId.description: A category of the live tree (422 unknown-category otherwise); required to publish.

allOf.title: ContentBody

schema.description: The response always carries description (empty when unset), bullets, attributes and media (empty arrays); primaryCategoryId is omitted when unset.
schema.title: ProductContent

404.description: not-found (the resource does not exist, or the path id is empty or longer than 128 characters). A NUL character in the path is a 404 resource-not-found.

500.description: internal-error. The detail never leaks the cause ("an unexpected error occurred"); a 5xx is never stored under an Idempotency-Key.
